scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the refuge construction, System (2), Theorem 1, the boundedness discussion, the Jacobian denominators, and Dataset (24). A closely related open full-text nonlinear-refuge paper was inspected for its explicit refuge-fraction restriction, and later citing discrete refuge work was checked for statement-level coverage. The bundled symbolic verifier checks the sharp boundary condition, exact counterexample, baseline source parameters, and singular curves. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result repairs the state space and positive-invariance theorem only. It does not assert that trajectories leaving the refuge-valid strip must hit a singular curve, and it does not re-evaluate later local or global dynamical claims that may remain inside a regular domain.

title: A sharp biological-domain invariance criterion for the predator-dependent refuge model
